name: Digital Modernization for Licensing Electronic Application Submissions
effect: FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to allow for submission of license and permit applications and requests for waivers, alternative time frames, and safety element approvals through additional electronic methods
alignment_notes: Streamlines launch approvals, but focuses primarily on airspace safety rather than orbital lifecycle tracking or on-orbit maneuver intent
sponsors: Lisa Cacciatore (FAA Office of Commercial Space Transportation)
